content.key_idea: A background figure explaining how a decoder-only LLM (exemplified by Llama2) processes tokens in prefill and decoding stages, the internal structure of a decoder block, and the detailed attention/FFN computation, motivating why LLM inference needs a KV cache and is memory-bandwidth bound.
content.reading_order: Left to right across three panels: (a) prefill then decoding-stage token flow, (b) one decoder block's internal layers, (c) Llama2's detailed attention and FFN computation.

summary: This is a background figure (not a diagram of the paper's own CENT system) explaining how decoder-only LLMs like Llama2 work, motivating CENT's memory-centric design. Panel (a) contrasts the prefill stage, which encodes prompt tokens in parallel through N decoder blocks, with the decoding stage, which generates tokens sequentially. Panel (b) expands one decoder block into input embedding, self-attention, add-and-norm, and feed-forward sublayers feeding an output embedding, softmax, and top-k sampling. Panel (c) drills further into Llama2's block, showing RMSNorm, the Wq/Wk/Wv projections with rotary embedding, key/value caches, the output projection Wo, and the SwiGLU feed-forward network built from W1, W2, W3. Blue, orange, and green flat-filled boxes distinguish weight/cache, normalization, and compute-layer elements.
summary_zh: 该图为背景说明图，展示解码器LLM（以Llama2为例）的预填充与解码两阶段、单个解码器块的内部结构（自注意力、前馈网络等），以及Llama2块中RMSNorm、Q/K/V投影、旋转位置编码、KV缓存与SwiGLU前馈网络的详细计算过程。
notes: This is a background figure explaining generic decoder-only LLM / Llama2 internals, not a diagram of the paper's own CENT system.
